use_case_summary: QueueBridge operates omnichannel contact centers for retail clients. Primary goal: reduce AHT and agent context-switching via real-time agent assist + automated ticket summarization. Critical secondary goal: survive and maintain SLOs during short-duration incident bursts and predictable seasonal peaks (e.g., Black Friday). Also needs reliable tool-calling hooks (CRM updates, ticket creation) with idempotency guarantees.
preferred_latency_slo: p95 < 800ms for agent assist responses under normal load; p99 < 3s during sustained peaks; fallback to lightweight template responses < 200ms if model paths exceed p99 threshold
spike_requirements: Must handle 5x baseline traffic for sustained windows (2-6 hours) and 15x for short incident bursts (10-30 minutes) without dropping integration calls. Requirements include: autoscale to dedicated burst capacity, automatic fallback model routing (lower-cost quantized variant) under queue backpressure, prefix & KV cache warmup strategies for expected top-30 intents, and traceable graceful degradation (clear metrics for percent routed to fallback). Need acceptance criteria for POC: no >1% error rate on tool-calling during peak, p99 latency within agreed threshold, and clear rollback/playbook for canary failures.
